CustomField.description: Tracks whether a post-acknowledgement stewardship touch has been delivered for this gift. Allowed values: To Be Sent, Sent, Don't Send. Values are kept in sync manually with the FQS_Stewardship_Status GlobalValueSet used by the GiftEntry staging mirror; Salesforce blocks converting this existing inline picklist to a GVS reference. Stewardship is separate from acknowledgement: acknowledgement confirms the gift was received; stewardship is a follow-up outreach to deepen donor connection. Written by the FQS_Stewardship_Response flow. See .planning/fqs-gift-followup-redesign.md.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Status of the follow-up stewardship touch (email or task) for this gift. Set to "Don't Send" to suppress automated stewardship. Distinct from Acknowledgement Status, which tracks the initial thank-you.
CustomField.label: Stewardship Status
